prompt:

Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. Header text verbatim: "skydda". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "protect".
Scene: An adult in a waterproof rain jacket remaining dry during rain, droplets beading on the jacket while exposed surroundings are wet, clear protective function.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "skydda = protect.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Jackan skyddar mot regnet.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
styleReference: Established card style described in the prompt; no image supplied.
